body.message:
We can confirm the 4-month booking with a monthly rate of AED 4,700.so in total it will be 18,800AED for 120 nights.

Please note that to secure the 4-month reservation, payment for the first and last month, along with a deposit of AED 3000, must be completed upfront.

Once the booking is secured, the remaining rent can be paid on a monthly basis. Kindly let us know if this arrangement works for you.
